import json,urllib.request,urllib.parse
ids=['agent-vision-fuzz','agent-creator','agent-media','agent-growth','agent-pc-executor','agent-boss-conformance']
out=[]
for cid in ids:
 u='http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments?chatId='+urllib.parse.quote(cid)
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(u,timeout=4) as r: d=json.load(r)
  xs=d.get('assignments',[])
  xs.sort(key=lambda a:str(a.get('createdAt') or ''))
  a=xs[-1] if xs else {}
  out.append({'id':cid,'counts':d.get('counts',{}),'latest':{k:a.get(k) for k in ['id','state','text','repository','branch','expectedHead','currentHead','dispatchCount','lastDiagnostic','createdAt','updatedAt']}})
 except Exception as e:
  out.append({'id':cid,'error':type(e).__name__+':'+str(e)[:160]})
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=True,separators=(',',':')))

note: Read-only latest assignment context for core existing managed chats; no URLs
